using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class WebServicesTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_LatestVersion_ReturnsLatestStatus()
        {
            // Arrange
            var httpClientFactory = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
            var httpClient = new Mock<IHttpClient>();
            var httpResponseMessage = new Mock<HttpResponseMessage>();
            httpResponseMessage.Setup(m => m.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).ReturnsAsync("latest");

            httpClient.Setup(m => m.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(httpResponseMessage.Object);
            httpClientFactory.Setup(m => m.CreateClient()).Returns(httpClient.Object);

            var webServices = new WebServices();
            webServices.HttpClientFactory = httpClientFactory.Object;

            // Act
            webServices.CheckModVersion();

            // Assert
            await Task.Delay(100); // Wait for the task to complete
            Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Latest, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_OutdatedVersion_ReturnsOutdatedStatus()
        {
            // Arrange
            var httpClientFactory = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
            var httpClient = new Mock<IHttpClient>();
            var httpResponseMessage = new Mock<HttpResponseMessage>();
            httpResponseMessage.Setup(m => m.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).ReturnsAsync("outdated");

            httpClient.Setup(m => m.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(httpResponseMessage.Object);
            httpClientFactory.Setup(m => m.CreateClient()).Returns(httpClient.Object);

            var webServices = new WebServices();
            webServices.HttpClientFactory = httpClientFactory.Object;

            // Act
            webServices.CheckModVersion();

            // Assert
            await Task.Delay(100); // Wait for the task to complete
            Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Outdated, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
        }
    }
}
